claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white PlayStation console and a DualSense-style wired controller, but do not show the exact PS5 model/version or any PS5-specific markings.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game and accessories.
claims.evidence: Witness report lists a power/AV cable and a small accessory bag/pack, but no FIFA disc or clear FIFA/game packaging is shown.

risks.risk: Console model/version and storage size are unknown (could be PS4/PS5 or different PS5 editions), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/model number (e.g., on the back/bottom) and storage capacity shown in system settings (if the seller can power it on).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for an unverified PlayStation 5 bundle: treat as not confirmed PS5/unknown storage and assume minimal included accessories only.

risks.risk: Working status is unknown (no power-on/HDMI/disc drive test shown).
risks.proof: Short video clip: power on → HDMI display shows the home screen; if disc drive is claimed, insert the disc and show it loading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested (worst-case), since functionality cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical condition is unknown beyond the visible angles (scratches, dents, port wear, overheating/fan issues).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: all ports (HDMI, power, USB), side vents, and any visible damage; plus a clip showing fan noise/thermals after a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst visible/unknown cosmetic case: assume wear consistent with used electronics and no special condition.

risks.risk: Controller condition is unknown (stick drift, button responsiveness, cable integrity).
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller connected and responding in a simple on-screen test (moving sticks, pressing buttons) and showing the cable connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a controller with unknown health: assume possible drift or cable issues and value accordingly.

risks.risk: Included items are uncertain (accessories bag contents not shown; FIFA disc not shown).
risks.proof: Photo spread laying out every included item individually (power cable, HDMI cable, controller cable/charging method, any game discs, manuals/box).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller + only the clearly shown cables/accessory bag, with no game disc included.

risks.risk: Account/console status unknown (bans, linked accounts, factory reset status).
risks.proof: Photo/video of system settings showing the console is signed out or factory reset status (and any account/billing screen if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case: assume account status may be problematic and treat as higher risk for buyer.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model number/label (back or bottom) and storage capacity.
Short video: power on + HDMI output to the home screen.
If disc drive/FIFA is claimed: video inserting the FIFA disc and showing it loads.
Close-up photos of all ports and vents; any visible damage.
Controller test video: stick movement and button presses responding on-screen; show cable connection.
Lay out and photograph every included accessory individually (including what’s inside the accessory bag).
Show system settings for sign-in/reset status (factory reset or signed out).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PlayStation console and a DualSense-style wired controller, but they do not verify PS5 model/storage, working status, or whether FIFA/accessories are actually included. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
